note: `grid[0][1]` is an element of a two-dimensional array of virtual interfaces that denotes `a`, so writing `grid[0][1].data` writes a.data (25.9). xezim 0.11.3 loses the write and prints a.data as xx; with a one-dimensional or package array it writes the member. Verilator 5.052 and Celox print 12.
